name: Error
meaning: Wraps an error into a JSON object: errorCode (empty → 0, else numeric). For codes >= -1 it adds errorMessage from Error.Description. If the code is 0 it returns only {errorCode:0}; otherwise adds scriptName (Get ScriptName), type 'FM', descriptor and data (as JSON object). Code -2 is used throughout as the custom-error convention. Variant: same logic as the base Error but without the header comment.

name: Error.Description
meaning: Lookup table: maps a FileMaker error code to its English description with nested range Cases (0, <100, <200, <300, <500, <700, <800, <900, <1200, <1300, else). Unknown codes inside a range return 'Unknown error code'. Pure data lookup; no I/O. Variant: code 301 returns static 'Record is in use by another user' (no Get(LastErrorDetail)); the last branch (1507) has no 'Unknown error code' fallback; no header comment.

name: Date.FromISO
meaning: Parses an ISO 8601 date text (calendar YYYY-MM-DD / YYYYMMDD, week YYYY-Www-D, ordinal YYYY-DDD; time part after 'T' ignored) into a FileMaker date. Reduced precision returns the first day of the period. Empty returns empty; invalid returns text '? Not a valid ISO 8601 date' plus the input. Third-party function (Jeremy Bante, modularfilemaker.org).

name: FilterValuesByExpression
meaning: Filters a return-separated list by a FileMaker expression: builds a Let/If expression string per item (item bound to the value text) and runs Evaluate on a List() of them. Returns the values for which the expression is true. Dynamic code: the expression is arbitrary FileMaker calc text; values are interpolated into quoted strings without escaping embedded quotes. Variant: original 2013 header, same code.

name: SQL.GetColumn
meaning: Returns all values of columnField for records where whereField = whereValue, using ExecuteSQL with a bound parameter. Field/table names come from GetFieldName via the SQL.Get*Name helpers (quoted). Variant: builds the SELECT/FROM/WHERE list inline (WHERE field = ?) instead of through SQL.GetColumnStatement; the first sql variable is overwritten.

name: JSON.ArrayConcat

name: JSON.ArrayFromRelated

name: JSON.ArrayLength
meaning: Returns the number of elements of the JSON array at path (empty path = the root). Returns 0 when the element at path is not an array or JSONListValues returns an error (value starting with '?'). Variant: strips CR/LF and replaces the word null with "NULL" before counting, so null items count.

name: JSON.ContainsProperty
meaning: Tests whether a JSON object contains a property; supports dotted paths (a.b.c) by recursing into the first segment's element with the remainder. Otherwise checks that name matches one of JSONListKeys(json) via FilterValues (case-insensitive). Dot detection requires a '.' and a minimum length (see variant). Variant: dotted-path branch when Length(name) > 3 (a 3-character path such as 'a.b' falls to the key lookup).

name: JSON.FilterByExpression
meaning: Filters a JSON array by a FileMaker expression evaluated per element with the element exposed as $item. Iterates by recursion, deleting the head element each round and accumulating passing items in $newArray (a $-variable that is reset on return). Returns the filtered array text. Relies on $-variable side effects across recursive calls. Variant: plain filter, no date/time string handling.

name: JSON.Format
meaning: Validates and pretty-prints JSON via JSONFormatElements. Returns the formatted text when valid; otherwise returns a JSON error object (see variants for fields). name: JSON.Validate.IsRequired
meaning: Older validator rule: value at path in $JSONToValidate must be non-empty, else JSON.Error.Validation '"path" is required'. Also sets $$LOG to empty as a side effect (global variable reset, unrelated to validation).

name: JSON.Validator.ApplyRules
meaning: Older validator: clears $JSONToValidate; if the rule list is empty returns Error(0;"";"") (no-error object), else builds JSON.Error.Validation('Applying Rules', json) and attaches the collected rule errors under the key 'errors ' (key has a trailing space).

name: JSON.Validator.SetJSON

name: SQL.GetColumnStatement

name: Config
meaning: Reads a value at path from the JSON held in global $$LL_API_Config (LedgerLink API configuration). Used to look up per-entity field names (e.g. '<Entity>.fields.fmId'). Contents of the global are set elsewhere.

name: Config.CurrentEntity
meaning: Marked @Obsolete. Reads Config(<QBO::selectedEntityName>.<path>), i.e. config scoped to the entity currently selected in the QBO table's selectedEntityName field.

name: QBO.Error
meaning: LedgerLink error object: Error(-2; descriptor; data) plus errorMessage 'LedgerLink Error' and type 'LedgerLink'.

name: JSON.Error.Validation
meaning: Builds a JSON error object: scriptName, descriptor, data (raw), errorCode -2, type 'JSON', message 'JSON failed validation'.

name: QBO.LookupFMId
meaning: Maps a QuickBooks Online id to the FileMaker id: reads the field names Config('<Entity>.fields.fmId') and Config('<Entity>.fields.qboId') then returns SQL.GetColumn(fmId field; qboId field; QBOId) — all FM ids of records whose QBO id matches. Returns a list (return-separated) of ids.

name: QBO.LookupQBOId
meaning: Reverse lookup: given a FileMaker id, returns the QBO id(s) via SQL.GetColumn(qboId field; fmId field; fmId) using field names from Config('<Entity>.fields.fmId'/'qboId').

name: QBO.LookupFMIdLine
meaning: Looks up the FileMaker id of a line item by QBO line id and parent id: SQL.GetColumn2Fields(fmId; qboId; QBOId; parentId; ParentID) with field names from Config('<Entity>.fields.line..fmId' [sic double dot], '.fields.line.qboId', '.fields.line.parentId'). The double dot in the first key looks like a typo that would resolve to a different config path.
target_signature: (entity: string, qboLineId: string, parentId: string) => string[]

name: JSON.FilterPropertyByExpression
meaning: Filters the array found at pathToArray inside arrayOrObject by applying FMExpression to the property propertyToFilter of each item (builds `JSONGetElement($item; "prop") <FMExpression>` and calls JSON.FilterByExpression), then writes the filtered array back at that path. If the value at the path is not an array, returns a JSON.Error.Invalid object with customFunction name and the parameters.
target_signature: (json: object, pathToArray: string, property: string, predicate: (value: unknown) => boolean) => object

name: JSON.Error.Invalid
meaning: Builds a JSON error object: scriptName (Get ScriptName), descriptor, data (raw JSON), errorCode -2, type 'JSON', message 'Invalid JSON' (type is written twice with the same value).

name: QBO.LookupRelatedLinesFMId
meaning: Returns the FileMaker ids of the line records belonging to a parent, ordered by the line-number field: SELECT via SQL.GetColumnStatement(lineFMId; lineParentId; '?') plus ORDER BY the Config('<Entity>.fields.line.lineNumber') column, executed with ParentId as the bound parameter.

name: AntiFilterValues
meaning: Returns values that are only in ListA and not in ListB (set difference), preserving order and duplicates handling per the header examples. Empty ListA returns empty; empty ListB returns ListA. Implemented recursively with a sentinel '##END##' kept in local var $Top (cleared at the end) and unrolled Substitute passes for up to 20 items per pass. Uses a $-variable ($Top) as hidden state.

name: QBO.Error.BadRequest
meaning: Builds a QuickBooks Online 400 error object from scratch: scriptName, descriptor, data (raw), errorCode -2, errorMessage '400 Bad Request!', code '400' (string), type 'QBO' (an earlier 'type' key set to 'JSON' is overwritten by the later 'QBO' value).
